integrity: The derivation gives an exact finite-dimensional Gram representation, an analytic spherical-kernel expansion, a bounded-vector CLT and explicit constants. Finite numerical checks are supplementary and no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The universal second-order law is proved only for three observations, independent identically distributed atomless scalar coordinates, exact sphere integration and column-wise sample-standardization. It does not address general-covariance whitening, growing sample size, or finite-dimensional equality of power.
title: A universal three-observation chi-square limit for a spherical characteristic-function test
